description: This file defines the IStateMachineStorage interface, which provides methods for managing persistent storage of state machine logs, including reading, replacing, appending, deleting logs, and querying snapshot requests.

classes.name: IStateMachineStorage
classes.description: An interface providing storage operations for state machines, such as reading log segments, replacing logs, appending segments, deleting logs, and checking snapshot requests.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Reads all log segments belonging to this state machine instance asynchronously, returning an ordered collection.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Atomically replaces the current log with the provided value.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Atomically appends a segment to the log.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes the state machine's log atomically.

methods.name: IsCompactionRequested
methods.description: Indicates whether the state machine has requested a snapshot (boolean property).
